defect: an always-on retention register is reset by the switched-off domain
rationale: When the switched domain powers down, its reset release pipeline is not a valid always-on reset source and can erase retained_q asynchronously.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

mutation.description: Drove the always-on retention bank from a reset synchronizer clocked in the power-gated domain.

labels.note: The always-on consumer is released by a reset synchronized only to the unrelated switched clock.
